x: Bill Jones, competing in the Batley Services Walk, writes: " I have every respect for a fellow who can race 12½ miles in Army boots over one of the vilest cobbly and hilly courses I've ever seen—and like it!
Bill Jones, from Yorkshire, is strolling over the Bradford 15 course, and hopes to put up a good show. Hopes that at least 3 members will enter in order to make up a team.
Bill Jones, still keeping our colours flying in Yorkshire, finished 23rd in the Bradford Whitsun Walk (15½ miles) in 2h. 37m. 35s. Jack Rutland has recently been promoted to Bombardier.

Jeff Dickinson is another who is now with the R.A.F., and was last heard of in the Cambridge district, further news is awaited. Bill Jones still up in Yorkshire, where he gets an occasional race. We were all pleased to see him "take his bashing" in the Club Open.
Bill Jones was unable to have his annual spin in the Bradford Walk owing to damaged ribs. He is now well again and doing a bit of strolling round Leeds way.
